verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it.
Say to it, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate wasteland.
I will turn your towns into ruins, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
You have always been an enemy of Israel. You handed the Israelites over to the sword in their time of disaster, the time of their final punishment.
So as surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will hand you over to bloodshed, and bloodshed will chase you. Because you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will chase you.
I will make Mount Seir a desolate wasteland and cut off everyone who comes and goes there.
I will fill your mountains with the dead. Those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
I will make you a ruin forever. No one will live in your towns. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
You said, "These two nations and these two countries will be ours, and we will take them over," even though the LORD was there.
So as surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will treat you with the same anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred toward them. I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard all the insults you spoke against the mountains of Israel. You said, "They have been ruined and handed over to us to devour."
You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.
This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth celebrates, I will make you a wasteland.

You celebrated when the land of Israel, which belonged to my people, was ruined. So I will do the same to you. You will be ruined, Mount Seir, and all of Edom with you. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
